attempts.surface: Expert management iframe via Electron CDP + Playwright; independent filesystem readback

actual_preconditions.expert_manager: 9 local experts before duplicate import; source round-owned only
actual_preconditions.fixture: night-agent-complete-20261006 already imported by this round

attempts.input: Reimported the same round-owned package with the same internal name and selected 作为副本 after the UI reported that the name already existed.
actual_steps: Opened 导入专家 and selected the same harmless round-owned directory using the page webkitdirectory input.
Clicked 提交; the UI reported 名称冲突 and stated that night-agent-complete-20261006 already existed, with options 覆盖现有 and 作为副本.
Selected 作为副本. The UI returned to the list with count 10 and two cards sharing the display name.
Independently read the product root: the original directory and a distinct night-agent-complete-20261006-1 directory both existed; both contained agent.md and metadata.json.
Compared file hashes: agent.md remained byte-identical; the copy metadata had a distinct internal name.
attempts.wait_condition: Waited for the duplicate import action to close and the local list to show 10 entries; independently read both directories and hashes.

checkpoints.observed: The round-owned original remains as night-agent-complete-20261006 with agent.md SHA256 72168746226c7371f7f91159f39490eadad81201d06285b906a2c5edb3ab7d6c. Its package files were not edited by this attempt.
UI list count increased 9→10 and displayed two same-name cards. Product-root readback showed a separate night-agent-complete-20261006-1 directory with agent.md and metadata.json.

attempts.observed_result: The name-conflict flow offered an explicit 作为副本 action. Choosing it retained the original and created a distinct -1 product-root directory. This is limited to the two round-owned fixture instances.
attempts.notes: Round-owned duplicate retained for further testing; no preexisting user expert was changed. Pending bilateral review.

changes: Created a second copy of the round-owned night-agent-complete-20261006 package through the UI.
remaining: Both round-owned expert directories remain installed for continuing this round; removal is outside this attempted check.
